listening.title: A first call to a new company

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Good morning. My name is Nam from BrightSoft. Am I speaking to Ms. Hoa?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Office Manager)
lines.text: Yes, this is Hoa speaking. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Thank you for picking up the phone. May I give you a quick introduction?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Office Manager)
lines.text: I have about two minutes before my next meeting.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: That is enough. We help small offices manage contracts and invoices in one place.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Office Manager)
lines.text: We already use a system for that, but it is quite slow.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: May I ask how many people use it every day?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Office Manager)
lines.text: About twenty-five people in two branches.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Thank you. Are you the right person for software decisions, or your director?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Office Manager)
lines.text: I choose the tool, and my director approves the budget.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Then can we set up a call next Tuesday? You can test it without any commitment.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Office Manager)
lines.text: Tuesday at ten works. If it is not a good moment, I will call you back.

questions.q: How many people use Hoa's current system?
Who approves the budget at Hoa's company?
What do Nam and Hoa agree at the end of the call?
options: Hoa will buy the tool today
Nam will send an invoice this week
They will set up a call next Tuesday
